## Safety checklist
- [ ] No secret, key or token in the diff (privileged keys stay server-side)
- [ ] New behaviour is behind a flag and OFF by default where it touches learners
- [ ] Mastery, profile and recommendation calculations are unchanged (or the change is explained)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; I have not claimed anything passes that I did not run
- [ ] Linear issue linked
